title: Apple iPhone 18 Pro Glacier 256GB $2,060 Delivered @ Skytree
body:
Deal: Apple iPhone 18 Pro Glacier 256GB $2,060 Delivered @ Skytree

[Tanvry] isn't this $2049 at costco? I don't see how this is a deal unless i'm missing something
[dan-ozbargain] Thanks Tanvry, I don’t have a Costco subscription and my Officeworks wouldn’t accept that price match! Or some stores may not accept it. It is for anyone that does not have access, or an alternative.
[Tanvry] ahh fair enough, yeah I was able to pricebeat at OW for a 17PM without membership just a month ago so i guess it depends on your OW store. But even then if you buy the membership for $65 it'll still be cheaper
[HaydosK] they should have done that as that is their policy
[hawkeye93] May need Costco membership but you can cancel it afterwards. Some OW may not accept Skytree too. So YMMV.
[RandomDealHunter] Got the 17 PM price matched at OW with Skytree ($1710) recently. Pretty happy with its screen size etc. but they stopped price matching with Skytree the day after as I tried to do one for my wife as well. Surprised that they let you do that this time.
[montorola] Better to sign up for Costco $65 with code NEW20 (and get $20 off voucher later on) = $45 outlay.
Use OW to beat Costco's $2049 by 5%
0.95*2049 = $1946.55
+$45 outlay from earlier = $1991.55 for 18 Pro with a year of Costco Membership.
https://www.ozbargain.com.au/node/973796
[Brick50] Why the need to sign up to Costco? Did they make you show them your card?
[hawkeye93] Depends on the store. Some do ask for the membership proof.
